Zara looks around her room which looks immaculate. Zara was a tidy person, and she liked to show it with her belongings. The room was adorned with her favourite art pieces and her everyday objects.
Zara has school today with classes starting from 9AM, she should wear her school uniform and get there on time to avoid any punishments!

Wardrobe

Zara should attend the first day of school, she can bunk classes later if she feels like.

Go to the living room
